notes.title: Anode Heart 2 announcement!
notes.content:
It's official! [b]Anode Heart[/b] is getting a mainline sequel! ːsteamhappyː

[b]Wishlist:[/b]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3568570/Anode_Heart_2/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3568570/Anode_Heart_2/[/url]

The spinoff I'm currently working on, [b]Layer Null[/b], will still take development priority, but once that's wrapped up, I'm committing myself 100% to AH:2.

Like the first game, the sequel will be a monster tamer game, and it will be set a bit further into the future, after certain.. world-changing events. Battles will be expanded into a 3v3/4v4 system, with influences from tactics RPGs and classic monster taming games. You can expect at least a 120+ new Tama, and 20-30 fan favorite returners from the first game. Check out the full info and the teaser trailer on its Steam page!

[previewyoutube=DzSXURc7Pk8;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you all for stopping by and see you soon !

notes.title: New Anode Heart game; [Layer Null] page is Live!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I've been working on this for about 4 months now and I can finally officially announce it.
[Anode Heart: Layer Null] is the next game in the Anode Heart Universe!

[b]Wishlist on Steam:[/b]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3068670/Anode_Heart_Layer_Null/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3068670/Anode_Heart_Layer_Null/[/url]

[b][Layer Null][/b] is a standalone card battler RPG, based on the card minigame from the first Anode Heart game. It's set in the same universe, but on a completely new Layer of the A:H world, with new maps, mechanics, story, characters and villains. This game will serve as a bridge to the Sequel, that will take place on the far side of Zearth, shortly after the ending of the first game.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3068670/Anode_Heart_Layer_Null/][img]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3068670/ss_f44d3990b323f54a5f7327ac6b2e119463cb81d8.jpg?t=1723857485[/img][/url]

It's not yet fully confirmed, but I'm most likely planning to release the [b]first third[/b] of [Layer Null] into Early Access towards the end of this year. This would be a complete, fully functioning first third of the content (open for re-balancing and quality of life changes). More info on this and the release will come a bit later.

See you soon!

notes.title: v1.1.3 tiny tweaks patch
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

A tiny tweaks and improvements patch, [b]v1.1.3[/b] is up and running. Let me know if you encounter any issues.

[b]Patch notes:[/b]
- Added sorting options for owned cards
- Tweaked quests that require Tama to look at both active and benched parties
- Added a hint in Connor's dialogue to visit the Control Room
- Added a more accessible bank terminal in the Mansion

As outlined in the previous patch notes, I'm now developing a (semi-)sequel [b]card game[/b] Anode Heart project. It's on the verge of becoming a presentable entity, so I'm planning on publishing a Steam page for it towards the end of July/early August.

See you again soon!

notes.title: v1.1.2 patch + roadmap
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Aside from a few smaller bug fixes, v1.1.2 brings a new [b]Gameplay Settings[/b] tab with options for Wild Tama/Trainers/Bosses level scaling and a new "Auto-Potential" option, which auto-converts any Potential you get on level up or evolution into Stat points.

[Next Project: Roadmap]

[url=https://x.com/Stochasticcc/status/1783856247327895561][img]https://i.imgur.com/XLv5VOJ.gif[/img][/url]

With v1.1.2 done, I will continue to focus on the [b]next project[/b], the Tama card game! (and Spanish translation for Anode Heart in parallel) The card game will be a shorter project - a side game to play while the Sequel is developed. I'm building the card game with PvP support in mind, so online play with friends and tournaments are a potential thing, but it will still primarily be an offline experience. More news on that next month. 

You can follow the regular updates here:
https://twitter.com/Stochasticcc


Or in the Discord:
https://discord.gg/8dHUrWejSD


Thank you and see you soon!

notes.title: v1.1 :: Mythicals Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

The Mythicals Update (v1.1) is here! This is a (free) content expansion update that brings new (postgame) maps, quests, Tama to catch, new evolutions, items and more!

[previewyoutube=vK9NFjlnq8Q;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Full Changelog:[/b]

* 14 new Tama 
-> 9 new evolutions
-> 4 mythicals
-> 1 piglet

* 4 new postgame (Mythicals) Quests
-> 4 new maps and characters

* 10 new upgrade items
-> 6 new crafting recipes

* new card set (Booster 07)
-> automation cards and new card effects
-> (unlocked by talking to Sirio on the 2nd floor of Mr. J's School)

To start the postgame Mythicals Quests, you will need to have the following Sentients recruited to your town. Once they're in town, talk to them to start each of the quests.

* Rocksworth
[b]If not recruited:[/b]
- Go to the Scorching Sands pyramids and solve his quest there
- Go to Rain City and talk to the robot bartender
- Take the lift at the lowest level of the City to reach a secret area
- Enter the Control Room and talk to Rocksworth
- Go to Snowlands town (Northbridge)
- Follow him to the Ice Palace and find the secret passage

* Luna
[b]If not recruited:[/b]
- Go to Protocol Forest and catch 1 Dark Native element Tama for her
- Go to Snowlands town (Northbridge) and talk to her
- Follow her to the Snow Fields (where the Shovulf are, and catch 1 for her)

* Aoi
[b]If not recruited:[/b]
- Go to Protocol Forest and find the Awaz with the electric trap
- Activate the trap and wait for dawn
- At dawn, go to the pedestal in the forest where the blue light shines
- Talk to Aoi and then head back to the trap
- Talk to the Awaz and follow them to the Temple
- Rescue Aoi

-------------

As always, if you have any questions or problems, reach out to me in the discord or ask about it in the forums. Thank you for playing and following Anode Heart!

[b]-+ Future Roadmap +-[/b]

The base content I envisioned for Anode Heart is now complete. The next game I'll work on will be a sequel or a side-game, set in the same universe, but with a new story and new characters.

I hope to share more details on that within the next couple of months.

Follow updates on Twitter:
https://twitter.com/Stochasticcc

Or Discord:
https://discord.gg/YsYYreE

notes.title: v1.0.6.9 QoL and bugfixes
notes.content:
Hello everyone, I've implemented a few more quality of life improvements and tweaks this week. I hope you'll find them useful! As always, if you notice any bugs or have any suggestions, comment below or let me know in the Discord!

v1.0.6.9 Changelog:

Features/QoL:
* New item storage screen, complete redesign
* Added Level Cap game mode option*
* Added Level Indicator toggle machines
(one in Binary Forest, Circuit Shore, Cliffs and Meadow)
* Added reboots/souls EXP bonus boost and HUD indicator (in Tama Stats menu)
* Picked up items will automatically go to Bank if your inventory is full
* Faster skips of Evolution and Rebirth screens

Tweaks:
* Increase Fifou's HP affinity to 65% and Strength to 75%
* Shield Boost effect set to 10 Armor
* Shield Generator II effect set to 25 Armor

Bugfixes:
* Releasing Tama from storage fix
* Fixed funky collisions near the beach capsule and dummy training area
* Card AI will surrender now if it has absolutely nothing to do but die

------------
*Level cap:
- "Hard Cap" is the default option and that's how the max level worked so far
- "Soft Cap" allows you to gain EXP even if you breached max level, but as you go further beyond it, that Tama will gain less and less EXP
- "Unlimited" - max level exists, but is ignored. You gain full EXP regardless of it

notes.title: v1.0.6.5 improvements patch
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I decided to take one more week to focus on improvements, before tackling Mythicals. This patch brings some new features and tweaks that might help fix some of the gripes with the game's mechanics. I hope these changes will make the overall experience better. If you have any feedback, please let me know.

Changelog:

[major]
* Redesigned new Tama storage interface
* Raised reboot limit by 1 extra reboot
* World Map is now obtainable immediately from Mr. Shishi (old save files that don't have the World Map will also have it now by default)
* Wild Overworld Tama level indicators
* EXP curve tweaks ("Easy" is a bit steeper now, while "Normal" and "Steep" are a bit less steep)
* Starters and lots of stage one Tama now have the "Easy" EXP curve

[minor]
* Reduced the too high levels of early daytime area Tama (like Crables)
* All "Claw" techs are now Contact techs
* Added heart/sword icons on cards
* Added Glitch Frag location indicators on the World Map
* Added "Story Quest" indicator in the quests' HUD, for quests that advance the Plot
* Tournament ambush calculation tweaks (it's the same as wild Tama ambush calculation now)
* Extra EXP bonus is (proportionally) given to Active Tama whose level is less than the highest Tama level on your party
* Added more Red Whistles to shops
* Kylfou's Passive (Supersonic) now also gives 1 Speed Up
* Forest and cave battle ground tiles updated
* "Tiny Wing" set to 2/2/3
* Bash, Peck and Claw CP set to 4

notes.title: v1.0.6.x bugfixes and tweaks
notes.content:
Changelog:

(This is also a changelog for version v1.0.6.1 that was already out)

[major]
* Evolution requirements are now visible by default
* Added a cross-character quest in Kernel Dump (Tami/Rika) to give more in-game info about breeding Tama
* Gifting favorite items now has a chance to set Tama's capture chance to 100% immediately

[minor]
* Increased elemental resistance upgrades to 30% resistance
* Honeybee Passive tweak (more Beebee on the team = more Honey)
* Expanded Fowlhoo's level-up techset
* Fixed Overworld Tama shadow sprites
* Flatland visual tweaks
* Serpehyr Wisdom affinity set to 90%
* French language bugfixes and tweaks

I'll focus on translating the game and the Mythicals Expansion from now on, and any patches between now and then will only be for emergency bugs, if any pop up. The Expansion will come out sometime before the March Spring Sale, or at the very start of it.

Cheers

notes.title: v1.0.6 patch (French, and Offline PvP)
notes.content:

And - Offline PvP battles / Remote Play. You can export your Tama party and send it to your friend (as a file) and they can play against it in the Arena!

Full changelog:

[Major]
* Added French language (beta)
* Added Offline PvP / Remote Play battles (talk to the new NPC in the Arena, after clearing Rain City quests)
* Fixed ambush calculations
* Random Memory upgrade gives 2 random power ups now, and can be found in some shops

[Minor]
* Enabled battle log scroll
* Remove evolution requirements for Kobalith, and set Magic requirement for Kobolith to (min.) 50
* Nanake's Passive is affected by Lucky status and Wisdom now
* Stoic is affected by Lucky status now
* Fixed Paradisc's effect
* Fixed upgrades with element restrictions
* Sunee can be obtained before Yori's quest now
* Breeding (Egg) techs fix
* Fixed max level message prompt on reboot
* Nerfed Snowpile status to heal 10 HP per Snowpile
* Set Gatlinger as default evolution of Gatle
* Kernel Dump Tama Storage Machine disappears after Tami joins the town (and player is redirected to her)

Changelog:

[Major]

* Added 'Potential' info in the 'Breeding' confirmation prompt

notes.title: v1.0.4
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

This patch brings a lot of QoL tweaks and bugfixes, but it also introduces one new Tama that you can fish for (first spot is in Kernel Dump!) Catching this Tama will silently register it in your dex, but it won't show up in the actual dex yet. The [[b]Mythicals Expansion[/b]] will bring a batch of new Tama with it, so just consider Cardee to be an early preview of one of those new Tama.

If you've played DW3, you'll know exactly what Cardee is a reference to! ;)

[b]Changelog:[/b]

[Features]
* New (fishing) Tama; Cardee (and new fishing spots in Rainlands and Scorching Sands)
* Sewers Bugman shop upgrades after Rain City
* Added a new upgrade item that prevents level up stats gain (but you gain Potential)
* New Type of Chip (one is obtainable inside the [redacted] area in Flatlands)

[QoL/Tweaks]
* Flatland enemy and mechanics tweaks, iframes and more gems from smiley blocks
* Buffed Mono Element run Starters' stats affinities
* Hexou learns Magic Wing at level 2 now
* Exact Evolution requirements shown when Tama is added to Dex
* Luck affects upgrade items chance of inflicting effect
* Kobalth evolution requirements reduced to 30/40
* Snowlands map tweaks
* Upgrades that increase total attack power are now multiplicative
* Renamed 'Recover' to 'Heal' to make it more distinct from 'Recovery'
* Weight % transfer when rebooting is limited to weight gain only
* Battle options can now be cycled through

[Bugfixes]
* Fixed wrong description on upgrade items with % chances
* Fixed the hanging flash on icons in the Tama Potential tab
* Fixed the hanging flash on Tama portraits in the Stats tab
* Menu game pausing tweaks
* Flarle and Rokahtl's Passive fix
* Fixed Bunary's Passive description
* Fixed 'Flare Up' tech type
* Fixed Pierce Upgrades
* Fixed tech descriptions in Techs Dex and Techs Tab
* Fixed Flaming Dive and moves with that type of effect
* Unified generic recoil and burn recoil damage to reduce bugs
* Unified naming ('move' -> 'tech')

And a short-term plan for future patches:
* Focus on remaining bug fixes (if any) and suggestions (QoL/tweaks and nice to have features)
* Exploration of game life extension features like Remote Play (or offline PvP) and New Game+
* Exploration of extra game modes/settings like area level syncing

Until next time,
Stove :v:

notes.title: v1.0.2 patch
notes.content:
[b]Important:[/b]
Reboot potential formula changed a bit with this patch - there was a bug with unspent potential affecting reboot potential way more than it was supposed to. It has been tested, but since this is a big base formula change, if you notice any weirdness in stats/game progression now, please let me know right away.

[b]Changelog:[/b]

notes.title: Classic Digimon fans are digging this creature catching RPG I almost missed last week
notes.content: Just like with cozy farm sims, there are way more monster-taming PC games to choose from than there were only a few years ago. It's easy to miss some of the smaller contenders, so I'm glad I managed to catch Anode Heart. This monster taming RPG launched just last week and, based on what I've played in its demo, is doing a great job channelling the good old aughts... Read more.

notes.title: Patch 2; More options to deal with ASMs + lots of fixes and tweaks
notes.content:
Changelog:

[Major]
* Added a new item to deal with ASMs (found in Access Tundra)
* Reduced the effects of unspent Potential on reboot Potential
* Fixed [No Heal] status (it was ignoring upgrades that heal a Tama before)
* Reduced the effects of the Fear status
* Dodge is now increased by 2% times sqrt(your Speed)
* Tech swap confirmation box fix (no more random paying for glyphs)
* Gamebot crash fix (if you approach it with less than 3 Tama)
* Hatter softlock fix (when his Tama is stunned)
* Pushable NPCs sequence break fixes

[Minor]
* Player movement should be less jittery now
* [Reinit] Passive will only trigger on direct hit fatal hits now
* Storm Surge card fixed
* Fifou evo tree glitch fix
* Added Reboot screen music
* Added Segment Island shoveling
* Alt color of offspring is set to default color when breeding
* Rune Sword blueprint and recipe
* Tama that attack you when digging now won't ambush you always
* Elements table fix
* Timer Bomb fix

notes.title: Big inventory by default and other tweaks
notes.content:
- Expansion Disc has been removed from the Overworld (later on it may return to expand the inventory to an even bigger one)

- Instead, inventory is expanded by default from the start of the game. Your existing inventory should also become expanded if you already started the game. If it doesn't, please let me know!

- Digging for items while you have full Memory should transfer dug up items into the Bank now

- A few other tiny fixes

notes.title: Demo update
notes.content:
Demo version has been updated to v1.0-alpha, and this will probably be the final demo version before full release. Content has stayed mostly the same, but there are a number of QoL changes and improvements:

[list]
[*] Multiple save files
[*] Reworked settings screen
[*] Reworked party screen for easier swaps
[*] Steam achievements (5 are obtainable in the demo)
[*] More tutorials on TP and other early game mechanics
[*] Starter tech tweaks and buffs
[*] Tenn (the TV forest man) can now heal your party
[/list]
